title: Blue Cowboy by David Cale at The Bushwick Starr #bluecowboy #davidcal...
transcript: Last night, I caught the first preview of David Cale's new show Blue Cowboy. Told in the first person from the perspective of a writer from New York, it recounts a period of time he spent in Idaho for work and an unexpected connection he formed with a local rancher and his dog. Thematically, the closest thing I can compare this to is Brokeback Mountain, but only because I don't know of any other gay cowboy media. Unlike Brokeback Mountain, this story is about two men from very different worlds and what can happen when you allow yourself to be open in the face of unfamiliar territory. It's remarkably tender, sensual, and intimate. David's storytelling is very matter of fact with minimal frills, rendering a sharp emotional honesty that I found really touching. It's not clear to me how much of this, if any, is autobiographical, but it felt very real — I loved it. Blue Cowboy is running through November 1st at the Bushwick Starr. With that, another program for my collection.
